title: User directory
context: Trust & Safety needs a plain user list.
task: Return name, country and age for every user.
answer: SELECT name, country, age FROM users;

title: Creators
context: Accounts flagged as creators get monetisation tools.
task: Return user_id and name where is_creator = 1.
answer: SELECT user_id, name FROM users WHERE is_creator = 1;

title: Instagram reels
task: Return post_id, user_id and reach for posts where platform is 'Instagram' and post_type is 'reel'.
answer: SELECT post_id, user_id, reach FROM posts WHERE platform = 'Instagram' AND post_type = 'reel';

title: High-reach posts
context: Posts seen by more than 3,000 people.
task: Return post_id and reach where reach > 3000.
answer: SELECT post_id, reach FROM posts WHERE reach > 3000;

title: Young adults
task: Return name and age for users whose age is 18, 22 or 24.
answer: SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age IN (18, 22, 24);

title: Users aged 25 to 34
task: Return user_id and age for users aged between 25 and 34 inclusive.
answer: SELECT user_id, age FROM users WHERE age BETWEEN 25 AND 34;

title: Non-like reactions
context: Reactions other than a plain like.
task: Return reaction_id, post_id and reaction where reaction <> 'like'.
answer: SELECT reaction_id, post_id, reaction FROM reactions WHERE reaction <> 'like';

title: Platforms in use
task: Return the distinct platform values from posts.
answer: SELECT DISTINCT platform FROM posts;

title: Names starting with A
task: Return name for users whose name starts with 'A'.
answer: SELECT name FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'A%';

title: Most-liked posts
task: Return post_id, user_id and likes for the 5 most-liked posts (ties by post_id).
answer: SELECT post_id, user_id, likes FROM posts ORDER BY likes DESC, post_id LIMIT 5;

title: Newest friendships
task: Return user_a, user_b and created_at for the 5 most recent friendships (ties by friendship_id).
answer: SELECT user_a, user_b, created_at FROM friendships ORDER BY created_at DESC, friendship_id LIMIT 5;

title: Engagement rate per post
task: Return post_id and engagement_pct (2 dp) = (likes + comments + shares) * 100.0 / reach.
answer: SELECT post_id, ROUND((likes + comments + shares) * 100.0 / reach, 2) AS engagement_pct FROM posts;

title: Ad CTR
task: Return advertiser and ctr_pct (2 dp) = clicks * 100.0 / impressions.
answer: SELECT advertiser, ROUND(clicks * 100.0 / impressions, 2) AS ctr_pct FROM ad_campaigns;

title: Cost per click
task: Return advertiser and cpc (2 dp) = spend * 1.0 / clicks.
answer: SELECT advertiser, ROUND(spend * 1.0 / clicks, 2) AS cpc FROM ad_campaigns;

title: Name lengths
task: Return name and LENGTH(name) AS name_len.
answer: SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS name_len FROM users;

title: Handle format
task: Return '@' || LOWER(name) AS handle for every user.
answer: SELECT '@' || LOWER(name) AS handle FROM users;

title: Posts per platform
task: Return platform and posts count.
answer: SELECT platform, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM posts GROUP BY platform;

title: Reactions by type
task: Return reaction and count (as n), ordered by n descending then reaction.
answer: SELECT reaction, COUNT(*) AS n FROM reactions GROUP BY reaction ORDER BY n DESC, reaction;

title: Distinct posters
context: How many users have posted at all?
task: Return posters = COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) from posts.
answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS posters FROM posts;

title: Total reach
context: Sum of reach across all posts.
task: Return total_reach = SUM(reach).
answer: SELECT SUM(reach) AS total_reach FROM posts;

title: Total ad spend by platform
task: Return platform and spend = SUM(spend) from ad_campaigns.
answer: SELECT platform, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM ad_campaigns GROUP BY platform;

title: Average likes per post type
context: Which format earns the most likes?
task: Return post_type and avg_likes (1 dp).
answer: SELECT post_type, ROUND(AVG(likes), 1) AS avg_likes FROM posts GROUP BY post_type;

title: Average age per country
task: Return country and avg_age (1 dp).
answer: SELECT country, ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS avg_age FROM users GROUP BY country;

title: Reach extremes
task: Return min_reach and max_reach from posts.
answer: SELECT MIN(reach) AS min_reach, MAX(reach) AS max_reach FROM posts;

title: Users per country
task: Return country and users count ordered by users desc then country.
answer: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS users FROM users GROUP BY country ORDER BY users DESC, country;

title: Likes per user
task: Return user_id and total_likes = SUM(likes) per posting user.
answer: SELECT user_id, SUM(likes) AS total_likes FROM posts GROUP BY user_id;

title: Top 5 users by posts
task: Return user_id and posts count, top 5 (ties by user_id).
answer: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM posts GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY posts DESC, user_id LIMIT 5;

title: Prolific posters
task: Return user_id and posts for users with > 8 posts.
answer: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM posts GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

title: Posts with author names
task: Return post_id, name (as author) and likes for every post.
answer: SELECT p.post_id, u.name AS author, p.likes FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id;

title: Posts by Indian creators
task: Return post_id and platform for posts by users in 'India' with is_creator = 1.
answer: SELECT p.post_id, p.platform FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE u.country = 'India' AND u.is_creator = 1;

title: Reach per country
task: Return country and reach = SUM(reach) of posts by users from that country.
answer: SELECT u.country, SUM(p.reach) AS reach FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id GROUP BY u.country;

title: Reactions received per user
task: Return user_id (post author) and reactions_received = count of reactions on their posts.
answer: SELECT p.user_id, COUNT(*) AS reactions_received FROM reactions r JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = r.post_id GROUP BY p.user_id;

title: Age bracket
task: Return user_id and bracket: '18-24' if age <= 24, '25-34' if age <= 34, '35-44' if age <= 44, else '45+'.
answer: SELECT user_id, CASE WHEN age <= 24 THEN '18-24' WHEN age <= 34 THEN '25-34' WHEN age <= 44 THEN '35-44' ELSE '45+' END AS bracket FROM users;

title: Posts per month
task: Return month (YYYY-MM) and posts count ordered by month.
answer: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', post_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM posts GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
